memories.content: The atlas release build repeatedly gets cancelled by CI because it starts every run with a cold/empty cargo registry cache (no cache persistence configured), which adds ~18 minutes to the build, pushing total time close to or past the CI pipeline's 30-minute auto-cancel threshold. This is a structural timing issue, not a code regression or flaky test. Fix: add persistent cargo registry/target caching (e.g. actions/cache keyed on Cargo.lock, or sccache) to the release build job.
